fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Notifications
fields.description: MASTER ON/OFF switch. When OFF (default) no WhatsApp is ever sent and the system behaves exactly as before. Turn ON only after the Provider (TS WhatsApp Provider) credentials and at least one approved template are filled in.

fields.label: Sandbox Mode (only message test numbers)
fields.description: When ON (default) ONLY the numbers in 'Test Numbers' receive messages; everyone else is skipped and logged. KEEP ON while testing so real staff/suppliers are never messaged by accident.

fields.label: Test Numbers (sandbox allowlist)
fields.description: While Sandbox Mode is ON, only these numbers can receive messages. Comma / newline separated, each 91XXXXXXXXXX. Example: 919812345678, 919900112233

fields.label: Respect Blacklist
fields.description: When ON (default) the provider skips numbers on its blacklist / opt-out list. Leave ON to honour opt-outs. (Used by Airtel's filterBlacklistNumbers.)

fields.label: Delivery / Inbound Webhook Secret
fields.description: A secret YOU choose and give to your provider; it must be sent back (X-Callback-Token header) on webhooks, so forged callbacks are rejected. Use a long random string.

fields.label: Webhook Source IP Allowlist
fields.description: Optional: only these provider server IPs may call the webhook. Comma / newline separated. Leave blank to rely on the secret alone.

fields.label: Max Retries (transient errors)
fields.description: How many times to retry a send that fails with a TEMPORARY error (e.g. rate-limit / 5xx). 0 = never retry. Default 3.

fields.label: Reminder L1 (hours)
fields.description: FIRST reminder: hours a document may sit pending before the approver gets a WhatsApp nudge. Default 4.

fields.label: Reminder L2 (hours)
fields.description: SECOND reminder: hours pending before a stronger nudge. Default 12.

fields.label: Reminder L3 - escalate (hours)
fields.description: ESCALATION: hours pending before the reminder climbs to leadership (CEO / MD). Default 24.

fields.label: QC Stuck Threshold (hours)
fields.description: Hours a QC / inspection may stay pending before a WhatsApp nudge fires. Default 72.

fields.label: Variable Tokens Reference
fields.options:
How to fill the "Message Variables (recipe)" column: list the tokens below in order, comma-separated, to match your approved template's {{1}}, {{2}}, .... Add/remove tokens to change how many variables are sent.

fields.label: WhatsApp Templates
fields.description: Maps each business event to its approved template. Paste the provider template reference (WhatsHub360: template NAME; Airtel: templateId) and tick Enabled once it's approved. Rows with no ref / not enabled are skipped. The 10 rows are pre-created.
